messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync: postmortem actions for PhoenixEdge need clearer owners and intermediate checkpoints. We saw three recurring failure modes: VPC peering churn, on-prem conntrack/NAT limits, and a cleanup race that left attachments orphaned. Can we map owners + short mitigations?

Samir Patel: I'll take VPC peering. Short mitigation: conservative BGP timers + peer-health watchdog to suppress flapping peers. Long-term: metrics-driven route convergence tests. Will open RFC and schedule staging repro. ETA 7 business days.

Priya Rao: I'll own canary instrumentation and alerts. Adding active peering probes, route-churn alerts, and a dashboard for the customer. ETA 3 business days.

Jorge Alvarez: I'll own on-prem guidance. Action: add conntrack sizing notes, sample sysctl/iproute commands, and a preflight script for installers. PR incoming in 48 hours.

Elaine Wu: I'll own the cleanup bug. Plan: make cleanup idempotent, add lease+retry, and add integration test that simulates concurrent deletes. Target: patch to Dedicated minor in next maintenance window (next Tue).

Ron Keller: Temporary customer mitigation: limit control-plane concurrency and route to standby pool. Command provided in runbook; will add cost warning. Can do as opt-in if customer agrees.

InfraBot: Snapshot and logs archived: s3://redwood-incident-archives/phx/1768202468. Correlation id cid-phi-820.

SupportBot: INC-2026-712 created and linked. Initial customer note sent; they requested weekly updates.

Maya Chen: Action summary with deadlines: Samir (peering RFC + watchdog) due in 7 business days (1768797268); Priya (canary + alerts) due 3 business days (1768453268); Jorge (on-prem checklist PR) due 2 days (1768370068); Elaine (cleanup patch + tests) due next Tue (1768870068); Ron (mitigation runbook & customer brief) due 3 days (1768460068). I'll chair a weekly Friday sync until closed.

Samir Patel: RFC link and staging window posted: https://git.redwood/rfcs/peering-stability-176820.

Priya Rao: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/phx-peering. Added probe panel and alert thresholds; please review.

Jorge Alvarez: PR here: https://git.redwood/docs/phx-onprem-checklist-176820. Includes conntrack tests.

Elaine Wu: Patch PR: https://git.redwood/infra/cleanup-fix-176820. Tests included; requesting expedited CI.

Ron Keller: Runbook updated: https://confluence.redwood/ops/phx-mitigation. Added opt-in steps and cost note.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. Set ticket INC-2026-712 to in-progress and assign owners. We'll post progress in this thread. If blockers appear, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
